name: Weather
description: The weather on the days of a {module} that has days, such as a trip. Choose a service and the temperature unit on this {module}'s Manage tab. This {module} has no window of its own.
author: Coffee Pub

settings.label: Service
settings.help: Where the weather on each day comes from. None: no weather is shown and nothing is sent out. Only services that are free for commercial use are offered. A service is used only after the administrator of this server has accepted its terms, once for the whole server: until then nothing is sent out, whatever is chosen here. Only a signed-in administrator can accept them, never software; the credit is always shown with the weather.

settings.label: Temperatures
settings.help: Show temperatures in Celsius or Fahrenheit.

settings.label: Icon style
settings.help: There is one icon style, the weather icons of the design system. A choice will be offered here when a second style exists.
